subject: MAP: Vendor Onboarding / Procurement Steps for Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@acme.com>, Acme Corp Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:20:00 +0000
Subject: MAP: Vendor Onboarding / Procurement Steps for Acme Corp

Hi Elena / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for taking the time today 

	great first call. Attached is a draft MAP (MAP_Milestones_v1.xlsx) that captures the vendor onboarding / procurement milestones we discussed. High-level items below and proposed owners / target dates so we can align on what to slot into your procurement workflow (Ariba/Coupa).

Milestone: Vendor packet & tax forms
- Responsibility: Redwood (Marissa) to provide W-9 + vendor info; Acme to confirm vendor profile fields in Ariba
- Target: 2026-11-17
- Dependencies: confirmation of legal name and tax ID, secure method for banking details (DocuSign or portal)

Milestone: Ariba/Coupa vendor setup
- Responsibility: Acme procurement to create vendor record; Redwood (Camila) to provide required file formats and test contact
- Target: 2026-11-24
- Dependencies: completed vendor form, email address to invite into Ariba, sample PO/test invoice for validation

Milestone: PO issuance & first-month billing flow
- Responsibility: Acme (procurement/finance) to issue PO; Redwood (Finance) to confirm invoice details
- Target: 2026-12-01

Milestone: Contract finalization (if needed)
- Responsibility: Acme legal / Redwood legal (loop in sales ops)
- Target close date (MAP): 2026-12-15

Next steps / asks:
1) Can you confirm that Ariba is the source-of-truth for vendor setup?
2) Please confirm the contact + email we should use for the Ariba invite (required for Camila to start).
3) Any additional vendor documents required by Acme beyond the typical W-9 and vendor form?

I've attached the MAP draft for tracking, and will follow up with the W-9 and vendor info form in a separate email. Camila is the owner on the Ariba workstream and Rafael (cc'd) will support approval/escalation if procurement needs an exec contact.

Thanks 

	looking forward to getting this into your system quickly so we can hit the target close date.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: MAP_Milestones_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, draft)

From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@acme.com>

Cc: Acme Corp Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Vendor Onboarding / Procurement Steps for Acme Corp

Thanks Marissa 

	useful summary. A few quick items from procurement before we proceed: 

- Please send your completed W-9 and a Redwood vendor information sheet (legal name, tax ID, address, remittance instructions). We need those to populate Ariba.
- We require the vendor onboarding form filled out (attached) 

	please return as PDF.
- For banking details, we do not accept bank info via email. If you can send via DocuSign secure field or provide instructions for a secure portal that works.

I've attached our vendor onboarding form for your vendor team to complete. Once we receive the W-9 and completed form we'll kick off the Ariba entry (usually takes 3-5 business days).

Elena Garcia
Sr. Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
elena.garcia@acme.com
Attachment: Acme_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF)

	thanks for the quick reply and the form. Attaching Redwood's W-9 and our vendor info form for your intake team.

- Redwood_W-9.pdf (stub)
- Redwood_Vendor_Info_Form.pdf (stub)

- Camila (cc'd) will own coordinating the Ariba/Coupa test entry and will need the procurement contact and the Ariba supplier invite email.

Camila 

	can you confirm you can start Ariba setup as soon as we return the completed form? Rafael 

	flagging in case we need a faster escalated path.

If Acme is good with the timeline in the MAP (target MAP close 2026-12-15) we will align internal resources to meet those dates.

Thanks,
Marissa

Quick operational note from Redwood ops on Ariba/Coupa onboarding:

- We can accept either Ariba or Coupa. For Ariba we need the supplier invite email (single email) and a contact name so we can accept the invite and complete the profile. For Coupa there is a vendor registration URL we will send to the Acme contact.
- Required fields we commonly see: legal name, tax ID (EIN), remit address, remit email, PO routing email, invoice remit instructions. If Acme has any custom fields please highlight them now so we can map in advance.
- Proposed owner: Camila Reyes (Redwood) will complete submission on our side; Marissa will coordinate DocuSign for banking info; Rafael will be point if procurement needs commercial escalation.

Suggested next call: 30 minutes on 2026-11-17 to confirm Ariba invite and walk through the completed form. If that works for Acme procurement, send the calendar invite and the contact to invite.

Thanks 

	I

	ll prepare a short checklist to share with procurement once they confirm the invite email.

Camila Reyes
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
